algorithms.multiply_note: Math.imul(a, b) -- an exact 32-bit product. Port as (a * b) & 0xFFFFFFFF in Python, or uint32 multiply in Go/Rust.

pitfalls.detail: JavaScript bitwise operators truncate to int32 and >>> yields uint32. In Python mask with & 0xFFFFFFFF after every step; in Go/Rust use uint32 types.
